total_note: Everything for the two of you
intro: Your flight to Paros, the Santorini ferry, island transfers and the sunset cruise, arranged through Original Senses, my partner in Athens. A deposit locks them in; the balance is due a month before you land.

transfers.title: All four island transfers
transfers.note: Paros airport to Vione, Vione to Paros port, Santorini port to Andronis Arcadia, and Andronis Arcadia to Santorini airport. Luxury vehicle with an English-speaking driver.

ferries.title: Paros to Santorini, Champions League Jet 1

boats.title: Private sunset caldera cruise on a Pardo 43
boats.note: Fresh fish, salads, dips, cheese and charcuterie, dessert, wine and beer, snorkel gear and a paddleboard, hotel transfers both ways.

flights.title: Athens to Paros, Olympic OA078
flights.note: 4:55pm to 5:40pm, Comfort Flex fares for two. There is no afternoon ferry from Athens that day, and the flight is far easier than the port: your driver takes you from the Zara stop to the airport, and a driver meets you at Paros airport for Vione.

pending_note: The Athens to Paros flight was added after your deposit link went out, so it is paid with the balance and the deposit stays as it is. Your own driver covers the Athens airport pickup, the Zara stop and the run back to the airport, so no Athens transfer is included here.

optional.title: A private driver in Athens for the day
optional.note: A luxury car with an English-speaking driver at your disposal for 8 hours, ending at Athens airport for the Paros flight. Instead of your own driver, if you'd rather. A licensed guide to take you around the city adds €700.

optional.title: Private full day to Antiparos, Despotiko & Panteronissia
optional.note: Axopar 28 with your own captain, towels, snorkel gear, water toys, snacks and drinks, hotel transfers both ways.

photo.caption: An Axopar day boat

optional.title: Or a half day on the bigger Axopar 37
optional.note: Same islands, shorter day, more boat.

photo.caption: The Axopar 37

how: The deposit is set by Original Senses under their terms: 25% of transfers and experiences, the full ferry fare and 30% of private boat charters. The balance is due 30 days before you arrive. Boats and ferries go fast in high season, so it is worth locking them in early.
optional_note: Not in the total above. Tell me if you'd like any of these and I'll add them; the deposit stays the same and they go into the balance.
